preconditions.expression: T == int(T) and T > 0 and T <= 10**5
preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases, bounded by 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(N == int(N) and N > 0 and N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit() and int(line) <= 10**5])
preconditions.description: Each N is a positive integer representing half the length of S, bounded by 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == 2 * int(N) and all(c in '01' for c in S) for N, S in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]]))
preconditions.description: Each S is a binary string of length 2*N, where N is the corresponding input.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N or output_line.strip() == '-1' for N, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a list of N distinct indices in increasing order or '-1'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(idx) <= 2*N for idx in output_line.split()) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for N, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Each index in the output list is within the valid range [1, 2*N].

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(output_line.split())) == N if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for N, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The indices in the output list are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(output_line.split()[i]) < int(output_line.split()[i+1]) for i in range(N-1)) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for N, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The indices in the output list are in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: all((output_line.strip() == '-1') == (not any(len(set(S[i] for i in A)) == N and len(set(S[i] for i in [j for j in range(1, 2*N+1) if j not in A])) == N and ''.join(sorted(S[i] for i in A)) != ''.join(sorted(S[i] for i in [j for j in range(1, 2*N+1) if j not in A])) for A in [list(map(int, output_line.split()))] if output_line.strip() != '-1')) for N, S, output_line in zip([int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()], [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', there exists a valid partition where A is the set of indices for subsequence P, and P and Q are subsequences of length N, disjoint, and not equal.
